olivia_cs: Heads-up: Solaris Health has an APAC partner demo 09:00 SGT. They hit 429s last pilot. Request temporary APAC egress allowlist + short burst (~550 QPS) for 4h. Must forward X-Solaris-Session header. Can someone own apply + rollback?

sam_netops: Paste CIDRs and UTC window and I'll own it. Edge-level allowlist + header passthrough?

olivia_cs: CIDRs (redacted): 203.0.113.11/32, 198.51.100.66/32. Window: 2026-09-05 01:00 -> 05:00 UTC (09:00 -> 13:00 SGT). Edge allowlist + header passthrough. Project: solaris-prod. Renewal note: demo success will influence pilot -> paid.

sam_netops: I'll create an ephemeral apac policy with auto-revoke at 05:00 UTC, steady qps 60 burst 550, tag pilot-solaris for billing. CLI (infra box): redwoodctl policies create --name solaris-apac-demo --project solaris-prod --region apac --cidrs 203.0.113.11/32,198.51.100.66/32 --header-forward X-Solaris-Session --qps 60 --burst 550 --expires 2026-09-05T05:00:00Z --tags pilot-solaris,billing,auto-revoke
june_eng: Add Grafana panel + a #eng-sre alert if 429 > 0.5%. Canary to apac-edge-1 for 10m then roll.

deploy-bot: policy solaris-apac-demo created (edge-policy-5533) in apac-edge-1 (canary).

sam_netops: smoke curl returned 200 and header preserved, no 429s in first 8m. Rolling to apac-edge-2/3. Billing tag applied.

finance-bot: billing export tag pilot-solaris registered.

deploy-bot: policy edge-policy-5533 rolled to all apac edges and auto-revoked at 2026-09-05T05:00:02Z (expiry).

olivia_cs: Demo success reported. Logging pilot metrics and customer feedback in account_health sheet and requesting steady-state quota uplift for renewal conversation. Thanks team!
